title: Show card numbers in Trello
question: How do I show card numbers on Trello cards?
answer: Trello has no setting that shows card numbers on the board; the number only appears in the card's link, as in trello.com/c/abc123/42-card-title. The usermods script on this page reads that number from each card and shows it as #42 in front of the card title on every list. Install it with usermods or any userscript manager. Without an extension, open a card and read the number in the address bar after the card ID.
prompt: Show each Trello card's number, like #42, in front of its title on the board.
details:
The number is the one Trello puts in every card link: trello.com/c/<id>/<number>-<title>. It counts up across the whole board, so it stays the same when a card moves between lists. The script only adds the #number label; card titles, links and dragging are unchanged.

The check runs on a public board while logged out. On your own boards the cards are built the same way, but the check does not cover them.

alternatives.title: Read it from the card link
alternatives.body: Open a card. The address bar shows `trello.com/c/<id>/<number>-<title>`; the number before the first dash is the card number.

alternatives.title: Trello Card Numbers Plus
alternatives.body: A Chrome extension that shows card numbers on Trello boards.

evidence.note: Chrome Web Store users, "Trello Card Numbers Plus"; count from CWS search page
Greasy Fork total installs, "Trello Card Number" (api.greasyfork.org, 2026-11-17)

check.baseline: (() => { const l = [...document.querySelectorAll('a[data-testid="card-name"][href*="/c/"]')].filter((a) => a.checkVisibility() && /\/c\/[^/]+\/\d+-/.test(a.getAttribute('href'))); return l.length >= 10 && !document.querySelector('.usermods-card-number') && l.every((a) => !a.closest('li').innerText.includes('#' + a.getAttribute('href').match(/\/c\/[^/]+\/(\d+)-/)[1])); })()
check.expect: (() => { const l = [...document.querySelectorAll('a[data-testid="card-name"][href*="/c/"]')].filter((a) => /\/c\/[^/]+\/\d+-/.test(a.getAttribute('href'))); return l.length >= 10 && document.querySelectorAll('.usermods-card-number').length === l.length && l.every((a) => { const tag = a.previousElementSibling; return !!tag && tag.classList.contains('usermods-card-number') && tag.checkVisibility() && tag.textContent === '#' + a.getAttribute('href').match(/\/c\/[^/]+\/(\d+)-/)[1]; }); })()
